basic_details.job_title: Visva-Bharati Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 4 Junior Engineer, Deputy Finance Officer and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Deputy Finance Officer, Senior System Analyst, Junior Engineer (Civil)
basic_details.short_information: Update: Visva-Bharati has issued a corrigendum dated 16 November 2026 to Advt No. 04/2026. The entry pay for Junior Engineer (Civil) is now Rs. 35,400 (Pay Level 6), the Deputy Finance Officer desirable qualification now reads "Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant / SAS", and the Deputy Finance Officer Paper-II syllabus now reads "CNA Account" instead of "CAN Account".

age_limit.age_details: Varies by post - see the table below

qualification.education_qualification: Deputy Finance Officer: Master's Degree with 55% and 5 years as Assistant Registrar or equivalent (Pay Level 10+). Senior System Analyst: B.E./B.Tech. (CSE) 55% + 9 years, or M.Sc. (CS)/MCA/M.Tech. (CSE) 55% + 8 years. Junior Engineer (Civil): B.E./B.Tech. in relevant field + 1 year, or Diploma in Engineering + 3 years.

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Master's Degree with at least 55% of the marks or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed; five years of experience as Assistant Registrar or in equivalent post in the Pay level 10 and above. Experience required: Five years of experience as Assistant Registrar or in equivalent post in the Pay level 10 and above. Age limit: Maximum 50 years. Pay: Pay Level 12 with Entry Pay of Rs. 78,800 as per 7th CPC Pay Matrix. Qualification required: B.E./B.Tech. (Computer Science & Engineering) with at least 55% marks and 9 years of experience of extensive programming and system management; OR M.Sc. (Computer Science)/MCA/M.Tech. (Computer Science & Engineering) with 55% marks and 8 years' experience of extensive programming and system management

salary_details.pay_scale: Pay Level 12 (entry pay Rs. 78,800) for Deputy Finance Officer and Senior System Analyst; Pay Level 6 (entry pay Rs. 35,400) for Junior Engineer (Civil), 7th CPC

pattern_table.Subject: Test of Language: English or Hindi

exam_pattern.details: Negative marking of 1/4th mark per question for wrong answers in Paper I and Paper II Minimum qualifying marks: General/EWS 40%, OBC (NCL) 35%, SC/ST/PwD 35% Question paper bilingual (English or Hindi) except Paper-I part (iv) Extra time for PwD candidates as per Govt. of India rules

how_to_apply: Apply online through the Samarth Portal (https://visvabharatint.samarth.edu.in) by 20-12-2026, 11:59 P.M.
Upload self-attested copies of testimonials for age, educational qualifications, caste certificate, physical disability (if any) and past service experience (if any).
Pay the application fee separately for each post applied for.
Candidates employed with State/Central Govt/Autonomous body/University/Govt-funded bodies submit a No Objection Certificate from the employer with the online application.
important_instructions: Applicants may apply for more than one post but must pay the fee for each post separately Fees once paid will not be refunded Candidates staying abroad may attend interview through SKYPE or other audio-visual link if permitted All correspondence only by e-mail given in the application form Addendum/corrigendum only on www.visva-bharati.ac.in

content_sections.heading: How Will Visva-Bharati Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Deputy Finance Officer and Senior System Analyst: Written test (Paper-I and Paper-II) and Interview / Personality Test Junior Engineer (Civil): Written test (Paper-I and Paper-II) and skill test if decided by the University; no interview for Group B posts Document verification before declaration of results Paper-I (MCQ, 2 hours, 150 questions, 300 marks) for all posts: General Awareness, Reasoning, Mathematical Ability, English or Hindi, Computer Awareness Paper-II (MCQ, 1 1/2 hours, 50 questions, 100 marks): post-specific syllabus Interview/Personality Test of 100 marks for Group A posts; weightage 70% written and 30% interview Candidates called for interview limited to a ratio of 1:15 of vacancies No interview for Group C and B posts; Junior Engineer (Civil) may have a skill test if decided by the University

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Visva-Bharati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 20 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Visva-Bharati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies: 1 Deputy Finance Officer, 1 Senior System Analyst, 2 Junior Engineer (Civil).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Visva-Bharati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 20 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Group A Posts (Level 12) - UR/OBC: Rs. 1600. Group B Posts (Level 6) - UR: Rs. 1200. Group B Posts (Level 6) - SC: Rs. 300. Women applicants: Exempted.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Deputy Finance Officer: maximum 50 years; Senior System Analyst: maximum 50 years; Junior Engineer (Civil): maximum 35 years. Relaxation: University system employees Upper age limit relaxable as per Govt. of India / UGC rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Pay Level 12 with Entry Pay of Rs. 78,800 as per 7th CPC Pay Matrix for Deputy Finance Officer, Pay Level 12 with Entry Pay of Rs. 78,800 as per 7th CPC Pay Matrix for Senior System Analyst, Pay Level 6 with Entry Pay of Rs. 35,400 as per 7th CPC Pay Matrix for Junior Engineer (Civil).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputy Finance Officer: Master's Degree with 55% and 5 years as Assistant Registrar or equivalent (Pay Level 10+). Senior System Analyst: B.E./B.Tech. (CSE) 55% + 9 years, or M.Sc. (CS)/MCA/M.Tech. (CSE) 55% + 8 years. Junior Engineer (Civil): B.E./B.Tech. in relevant field + 1 year, or Diploma in Engineering + 3 years. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Educational qualifications must be from a University/Institute approved or recognized by the UGC / Ministry of Education. Qualification and experience counted as on the closing date of application. Appointees shall reside within the territorial jurisdiction of the University as declared in the Visva-Bharati Act, 1951. Selected candidates must go through police verification before or after joining.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: SC/OBC(NCL) candidates applying for unreserved vacancies get no age relaxation or relaxation in cut-off marks. Applications with incomplete information or without requisite fee shall be rejected. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.

Junior Engineer (Civil): Written test (Paper-I and Paper-II) and skill test if decided by the University; no interview for Group B posts. Document verification before declaration of results.
